Package de.hallerweb.enterprise.prioritize.config

Annotation Interface AuthenticatedUser

@Target(PARAMETER) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Documented public @interface AuthenticatedUser
Marks a controller method parameter as the PUser behind the current request. The parameter is filled by AuthenticatedUserArgumentResolver, which resolves the user once per request — controllers no longer take an Authentication and no longer carry their own getCurrentUser(auth) helper.

The parameter is never bound from the request itself; it is excluded from the OpenAPI document in OpenApiConfig, so a PUser parameter stays invisible to API clients.
